about: BLOOM-032B1 production plant sprite contract. The fixed rules every plant art pack (art/plant/packs/<pack>/atlas.png + atlas.json) is validated against by tools/build-plant-art.mjs. Human-readable version: docs/PLANT_SPRITE_PIPELINE_v1.md section ARTIST_HANDOFF. Changing this file is an ENGINE change (renderer + QA), not an art change.

canvas.note: One canonical logical plant canvas. Every placement (Adapt, Spread, Region Inspect, Field Journal) shows this exact buffer, scaled by a whole number with nearest-neighbour and padded; anatomy is never re-laid-out per UI.

pixel.format: PNG, 8-bit per channel; colour types RGBA (6), RGB (2), indexed (3, incl. tRNS) or grey (0 / 4); not interlaced
pixel.alpha: every pixel is fully transparent (alpha 0) or fully opaque (alpha 255); partial alpha is a build error
pixel.palette: every opaque pixel inside a sprite rect must be EXACTLY one of the pack's declared palette colours (atlas.json palette); arbitrary RGBA is a build error. A colour means a material + shade, so the renderer can recolour it (treatments, condition).
pixel.mask: a mask rect has the sprite's exact size; any opaque pixel (any colour) = inside the mask, transparent = outside
pixel.strays: no opaque pixel may lie outside every declared rect (sprite, mask, swatch)

materials.name: stem
materials.role: stem, petiole, stalks; also drawn procedurally by the renderer

materials.name: root
materials.role: roots; also drawn procedurally by the renderer

materials.name: pigLeaf
materials.role: TREATMENT TARGET: leaf under protective pigment (never drawn in a sprite)

materials.name: pigStem
materials.role: TREATMENT TARGET: stem under protective pigment

materials.name: pigCore
materials.role: TREATMENT TARGET: storage tissue under protective pigment

materials.name: waxLeaf
materials.role: TREATMENT TARGET: leaf under a reflective wax cuticle

pigment.note: Radiation Shielding: protective pigment. Recolours the masked pixels shade-for-shade; the procedural stem/branches take it too.

wax.note: Heat Tolerance: reflective wax. Contract slot only in 032B1 (no golden-slice state uses it); a pack may omit waxLeaf.

orientations.right: faces / grows toward +x from its anchor; the build bakes the mirrored left twin when "mirror": true
orientations.left: an explicitly authored left-facing variant; overrides the baked mirror of the same id
orientations.up: upright and centred on its anchor; never mirrored
orientations.down: hangs below its anchor; never mirrored

angles.low: near horizontal (about 10° above horizontal): the lower stem nodes
angles.mid: about 40° above horizontal: the middle nodes
angles.high: about 65° above horizontal: the upper nodes and the compact (cold) rosette

attach.leafSocket: a stem node's left / right leaf socket (the anchor = the petiole base, on the stem's edge)
attach.leafMargin: a point declared by the leaf sprite itself (points.tip / points.margin) — surface details ride on whichever leaf was drawn
attach.stemNode: centred on the stem at a node
attach.rootCrown: where the stem meets the soil line
attach.primaryRoot: on the primary root just below the crown
attach.flower: the flower socket (the apex, or the flower branch's tip when a seed head holds the apex)
attach.seedHead: a seed-head socket (index 0 = the apex, 1 and 2 = side branches)
attach.pod: a pod socket (side stalks low on the stem)
attach.drift: free points around the apex for drifting seeds
